BrutalDash device battery collector, version 0.1.53.

HaloBattery 1.11.0 providers and deduplication:
https://github.com/HeyOkay/HaloBattery/tree/v1.11.0
Copyright (c) 2026 Halo Battery contributors; MIT license included.
Input source ZIP SHA-256:
95d533f91d2c986bb90734bc51bf866e18aef6ad0a2029571df3448c4824d820
The supplied providers are retained, excluding generated __pycache__ files.
Tray UI, updater, diagnostics, autostart, and installer are not run or bundled.
BlackShark protocol support remains part of the Razer provider.

ASUS battery query is a separate implementation of status-report wire fields.
Protocol reference: https://github.com/seerge/g-helper at
f67703f68fd879626c9f6319aac9e80743a359e7, AsusKeyboard.cs / StrixScopeII.cs.
No G-Helper application implementation or restricted private-core code is bundled.
Locally tested: Scope II 96 through ROG OMNI. Direct and RX variants are
protocol support only, not locally hardware-verified.

Runtime: Python 3.14.7 Windows x64 embeddable distribution, PSF license in
runtime/LICENSE.txt. python314.zip is renamed python314.pak and the isolated
python314._pth includes it and the collector directory. No system installation.
https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.14.7/python-3.14.7-embed-amd64.zip
Archive SHA-256: d297e5ff019966817ad8502465176139f2d3d840fa4ed84b13bed399a6ab1f15

HID binding: hidapi 0.15.0 cp314 win_amd64 wheel. Included license choices
and notices are in hidapi-licenses; redistribution uses the BSD license option.

Polling: 30 seconds, in a persistent hidden helper. Parent closure kills the
entire helper process tree. No driver installation or vendor software needed.
Device support remains subject to the upstream model and connection limits.

Cloud III Wireless status reader added in 0.1.53. Protocol reference:
https://github.com/LennardKittner/HyperHeadset/blob/57dfa2b32ab73097be016006bf6580933536637e/src/devices/cloud_iii_wireless.rs
Only link, battery and charging queries are used. No configuration commands.
Logitech selection also accepts the reported FF43:0301/0302 HID++ collections.
Cloud III and C54F receiver support require remote hardware validation.

Additional Corsair/Arctis battery wire references: Sapd/HeadsetControl
25dadae5c5b834f94ee954513421def12c5d6305, corsair_void_rich.hpp,
steelseries_arctis_1.hpp, steelseries_arctis_7_plus.hpp.
Independent battery-only implementation; no upstream C++ application code bundled.
Direct FF43:0202 HID++ connections now included. See DEVICE-BATTERY-SUPPORT.md.
